Metadata.title: ImMiguel Dev — Full-stack engineering
Metadata.description: Juan Miguel León Gómez, informatics engineer and full-stack developer in Cali, Colombia. Web applications built with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker and AI.

Hero.subtitle: I build complete web applications, from the interface and API to the database, automation, deployment and AI integration.

About.headline: Informatics engineer focused on full-stack development.
About.layers: I'm an informatics engineer from Universidad Autónoma de Occidente and a full-stack developer. I work with React, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend; Node.js, NestJS, Express and Python on the backend; and PostgreSQL, MongoDB and MySQL for data persistence. I also use Docker and cloud services to ship applications to production.
About.effect: I'm currently pursuing a Master's in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, where I build on my software development experience with the integration of models, agents and AI services.

Skills.headline: The technologies I use to build full-stack applications.
Skills.body: Tools I use across web development, backend, databases, deployment and AI integration.

pevi.summary: Web platform for the Industrial Energy Assessment Center at Universidad Autónoma de Occidente. Users upload and validate energy data from Excel, review indicators and charts, generate reports and manage sessions with experts.
pevi.decision: The system adds data validation and a Vertex AI integration that supports technical recommendations. The solution cut query and analysis time by 40%.
pevi.imageAlt: Main dashboard of the PEVI UAO platform

dataBridge.summary: Integration service that syncs PostgreSQL data to Zoho Analytics progressively, removing manual spreadsheet exports.
dataBridge.decision: Updates run through controlled upserts and predefined SQL queries, with no arbitrary queries from outside and automatic OAuth token renewal.
dataBridge.diagramLabel: Sync flow between PostgreSQL and Zoho Analytics

westAutomation.summary: Corporate website for a Canadian industrial automation company.
westAutomation.decision: Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS and deployed on Vercel, with fast load times and straightforward content maintenance.
westAutomation.imageAlt: Home page of the West Automation site

barbershop.summary: Web application for barbershops that centralizes bookings, client history and role-based access.
barbershop.decision: Permissions are enforced on the server, so each role only accesses the information it needs.
barbershop.imageAlt: Booking calendar of the barbershop system

Experience.headline: Professional experience
Experience.lede: Experience in full-stack development, process automation and web solutions for academic and healthcare environments.

vallesalud.summary: I develop and maintain internal web solutions, including applications built on Zoho Creator and Zoho Analytics. I also implement Selenium and RPA automations to streamline operational processes; one of these workflows cut its daily run time from about 5 hours to 30 minutes.

uao.summary: I worked on the full-stack development of PEVI-UAO alongside another developer. We built energy data upload and analysis, dashboards, advisory session management and a Vertex AI integration on PostgreSQL. The application was containerized with Docker and deployed on Render and Vercel, cutting query and analysis time by 40%. The project was also presented at RedCOLSI.

master.role: Master's in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
